content.text:
**答案:** 1875 年,乔治·布朗(George Brown)拒绝了安大略省副总督(lieutenant governorship of Ontario)的职位。他想继续保持独立发言的立场,专心办《环球报》(The Globe)。

另外,他在 1879 年还拒绝了爵士头衔(KCMG)。这是另一件事,不是 1875 年的事。

**依据的网址:**
- https://www.canada.ca/en/parks-canada/news/2016/08/george-brown-house-national-historic-site.html(加拿大公园局:"refused both the lieutenant governorship of Ontario (1875) and a knighthood (1879)")
- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Dictionary_of_National_Biography,_1901_supplement/Brown,_George_(1818-1880)(DNB:"In 1875 Brown declined the lieutenant-governorship of Ontario")
- https://www.britannica.com/biography/George-Brown(不列颠百科,也提到他拒绝了副总督职位和爵位)

我一共搜了 2 次。
